$comment: The permission profile the JUDGE is launched with (role forseti; RULES/08, appended 2026-11-21 at the Allfather's word: every PR is reviewed by the judge, and an approval merges at once). It is the worker profile (claude-worker.settings.json) with ONE road opened: the merge door. Measured 2026-11-21: three judges approved PRs and were refused at the merge, because every Claude seat carried the worker profile, which denies `gh pr merge`; the arm holder merged by hand. The door is bin/forge/judge-merge.sh (act <review-id>: reads the verdict, then calls) bin/agents/pr-seal.sh seal <n> --repo <owner/repo> --head <approved-sha>, which re-checks at that instant — every check SUCCESS and none pending, mergeable, not a draft, no hold label, no state/.seal-hold, the head is the approved head, gh acts as the registry's owner — then merges with bin/forge/merge-method.sh's method and a written body, and carves one Rune. Raw `gh pr merge`, the raw merge API, `git merge` and every push to main stay DENIED, so the door's checks cannot be skipped. Deny rules win over allow rules; the explicit allow entries name the one road. Keep the env and the rest of the lists in step with the worker profile (tests/test_claude_seat_roles.sh holds it). Appended 2026-11-21 (the judge's review of #870): raw merge also hides behind gh's global flags (`gh -R <repo> pr merge`) and the GraphQL mutation (`mergePullRequest`); both are denied here and refused by the smith gh shim. Appended later the same day (the judge's re-review): `-R/--repo` may also stand BETWEEN `pr` and `merge` (`gh pr -R <repo> merge`), an alias can carry a merge, and the API path may end in a slash or change case; all are denied here and refused by the shim, which reads the subcommand past every flag, judges an alias by its expansion and matches the API path without case. A pattern list cannot fence a Bash that is open: the lasting fence is a judge-only token. Appended later still (the judge's third review): STOPGAPS, NOT THE FENCE. A push to main by any refspec (`HEAD:main`, `refs/heads/main`), `--no-verify`, the token leaving gh (`gh auth token`, `--show-token`, GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN, gh's hosts.yml) and a REST call to api.github.com or to any …/pulls/<n>/merge are denied, and so is the text `pr merge` itself, which also catches the real gh called by an absolute path with its name quoted. Every one of these has another spelling. The fence is on the server and in the credential: a worker seat holds a read-only token, and main requires a pull request with enforce_admins on (or a ruleset whose only bypass is the judge). Those are the operator's settings, not this file's.
